title: Garnet opens up

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: So, uh... you talked to Mila, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, uh... you talked to Mila, huh?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Look, the kid means well. And... she's very strong-willed. She's really pushing me out of my comfort zone, whether I like it or not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, the kid means well. And... she's very strong-willed. She's really pushing me out of my comfort zone, whether I like it or not.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Hey, snap! Thanks for being honest with me though. How did she take it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, snap! Thanks for being honest with me though. How did she take it?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: What? Uh, shit. I mean... good. So I guess you left her in tears?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Uh, shit. I mean... good. So I guess you left her in tears?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Every night I'm not dreaming of more friends. I'm dreaming of pizza that has real cheese. Imagine that!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Every night I'm not dreaming of more friends. I'm dreaming of pizza that has real cheese. Imagine that!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I know. She's a big girl!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. She's a big girl!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I don't get it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't get it!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: She died. Flora, my wife. While I was on shift. I knew she was sick, but I ... we needed the damn Lims!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She died. Flora, my wife. While I was on shift. I knew she was sick, but I ... we needed the damn Lims!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: She died in Mila's arms ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She died in Mila's arms ...

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: No, she's not. But she thinks I'm weak!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, she's not. But she thinks I'm weak!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I know, but what should I do? I'm soldiering on and hope it gets better. But it never does.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, but what should I do? I'm soldiering on and hope it gets better. But it never does.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: And Mila is eyeing me, protecting me, trying to give me the time and protection to heal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And Mila is eyeing me, protecting me, trying to give me the time and protection to heal.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: And then? I don't have the time to heal. I need those fucking Lims for paying the rent. I cannot afford a therapy animal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then? I don't have the time to heal. I need those fucking Lims for paying the rent. I cannot afford a therapy animal.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Like I'm in hell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I'm in hell.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I'm gonna talk to Mila. And I'll try to save. I guess I needed that talk! She's a child, I'm her father.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm gonna talk to Mila. And I'll try to save. I guess I needed that talk! She's a child, I'm her father.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: That's the axiom. Everything else concludes. Thank you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the axiom. Everything else concludes. Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I will! And I'll try to save. I guess I needed that talk! She's a child, I'm her father.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will! And I'll try to save. I guess I needed that talk! She's a child, I'm her father.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's gate-keeping you. And you shouldn't allow that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's gate-keeping you. And you shouldn't allow that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's gate-keeping you. And you shouldn't allow that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's gate-keeping you. And you shouldn't allow that.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Yeah, her heart is in the right place, but I really don't need any more friends, or partners, or... anyone really. Just me and her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, her heart is in the right place, but I really don't need any more friends, or partners, or... anyone really. Just me and her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Imagine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Imagine.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: So what happened with Mila? I assume you "passed" your interview?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what happened with Mila? I assume you "passed" your interview?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I cut it off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I cut it off.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This not about her. It's about you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This not about her. It's about you!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This not about her. It's about you!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This not about her. It's about you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's interfering in your life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's interfering in your life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She feels responsible for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She feels responsible for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yum.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yum.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not what I meant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not what I meant.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not good for both of you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not good for both of you!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's not good for both of you!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's not good for both of you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I probably did not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I probably did not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, she's not, she's still a child.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, she's not, she's still a child.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, she's not, she's still a child.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, she's not, she's still a child.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me what happened!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me what happened!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm waiting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm waiting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you're feeling guilty?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you're feeling guilty?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you feel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you feel?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I feel guilt, shame, loss, all at the same time. And I have to take care of Mila. And I know I'm screwing that up, too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel guilt, shame, loss, all at the same time. And I have to take care of Mila. And I know I'm screwing that up, too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you ever tell her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you ever tell her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you think she's stupid?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think she's stupid?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: She shouldn't have to carry my burden.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She shouldn't have to carry my burden.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But she does!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But she does!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you make her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you make her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And that hurts you even more!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And that hurts you even more!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And that hurts you even more!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And that hurts you even more!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have to talk about it. With her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have to talk about it. With her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have to talk about it. With her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have to talk about it. With her.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I looked up tariffs of decent psychologists. It looks like a therapy would be around 800 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I looked up tariffs of decent psychologists. It looks like a therapy would be around 800 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I paid for it, would you seek therapy for yourself and your daughter?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I paid for it, would you seek therapy for yourself and your daughter?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I paid for it, would you seek therapy for yourself and your daughter?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I paid for it, would you seek therapy for yourself and your daughter?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I cannot pay for every person in need. I wish you luck. Talk to Mila!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, I cannot pay for every person in need. I wish you luck. Talk to Mila!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry, I cannot pay for every person in need. I wish you luck. Talk to Mila!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry, I cannot pay for every person in need. I wish you luck. Talk to Mila!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have that money, either. But you need it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have that money, either. But you need it!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have that money, either. But you need it!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have that money, either. But you need it!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Of course I would! And I would try to pay it back!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I would! And I would try to pay it back!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here's the money. Go, save your daughter!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here's the money. Go, save your daughter!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Here's the money. Go, save your daughter!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Here's the money. Go, save your daughter!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Thank you. I don't know if you still want to be a friend. But I will always see you as one!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. I don't know if you still want to be a friend. But I will always see you as one!
